summary: Trust Center rebuild for Terms, Security, and GDPR pages VERIFIED COMPLETE. All three pages now render the premium trust-center experience with consistent structure. Critical regression check PASSED: /security page no longer shows 'useMemo is not defined' error and renders correctly. All test cases passed: (1) Public route access works for /terms, /security, /gdpr without redirects, (2) All three pages render premium trust-center components (hero, badge, title, family links, summary grid, sidebar, reading pane, action hub, contact panel), (3) Responsive behavior verified across desktop, tablet, and mobile with no horizontal overflow, (4) i18n baseline verified - no raw translation keys visible, (5) Family links navigation works correctly between trust pages.
